title: 3 Steps To Spend 50% Less Claude Tokens (Steal This)
description:
Comment "TOKEN" for the full token-saving playbook

Claude Code can burn your whole subscription in one session.

Most of that spend is clutter you never needed.

Three fixes:

Run /doctor. It health-checks your setup and shows what to cut.

Add an effort table to your claude.md. Sonnet for daily, Opus for the heavy lifts, everything on high.

Use /model or /effort to override effort/model on the fly.

Up to 50% back.

That's the unlock, fam.
